description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that wraps Android's native Log utility, providing static methods for various logging levels and managing a linked list of LogNodes for customizable logging behavior.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: Utility class providing static logging methods and managing a LogNode chain.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode to which logs will be sent.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches log messages to the LogNode chain; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message; overloaded for with/without Throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert/fatal message; overloaded for with/without Throwable.
